title: Utility Service Customer Request Form
subtitle: An original utility service workflow that preserves the customer's observation and routes a clear service response, with explicit qualified-review, stop-work, escalation, and accountable handoff controls.
description: A workflow-complete utility service customer request form for the electric, gas, water, or thermal utility service point that captures exact identity, domain observations, supporting evidence, decisions, exceptions, responsible owners, and closeout without replacing professional judgment or the organization's controlling procedures.
use_case: Use when a customer asks for service, investigation, or follow-up and staff need a traceable account of the requested outcome, symptoms, evidence, safety screen, communication, and disposition. The utility service coordinator owns routing, and closure requires documented evidence, disposition of restrictions, and acceptance by the designated reviewer.

sections.title: Utility service customer request and communication routing
sections.guidance: Capture the customer's own observation and give the request a clear service owner.

sections.title: Utility service requested outcome and customer constraints
sections.guidance: Describe the requested result without treating the customer's suspected cause as confirmed.

blocks.label: Customer request type
items: Start, stop, or transfer service
No service or intermittent service
Voltage, pressure, flow, or quality concern
Meter, bill, or usage investigation
Capacity or service upgrade
Equipment relocation or protection
Access appointment or missed service
Restoration or follow-up confirmation

blocks.label: Customer observation in their own words

fields.label: What was observed, when it began, frequency, affected service, desired outcome, and prior contact

sections.title: Utility service condition timeline and supplied evidence
sections.guidance: Preserve dates, sources, and attachments so service staff can distinguish symptoms from verified findings.

blocks.label: Customer-supplied evidence
items: Photograph or video reference
Bill, usage, or account reference
Display, alarm, or fault wording
Prior ticket or service record
Site plan, equipment document, or product reference
Access instruction, property permission, or appointment detail
Critical-service or accessibility information
No supporting attachment; follow-up owner assigned

sections.title: Utility service exceptions, stop conditions, and escalation
sections.guidance: Make every unresolved condition visible with an immediate control, owner, due point, and final disposition.

blocks.label: Stop-condition screen
items: Gas odor, hissing, suspected leak, or atmosphere concern
Downed conductor, arcing, exposed electrical part, or burn damage
Major water release, flooding, washout, or energized equipment in water
Steam, pressure, hot surface, rotating equipment, or uncontrolled stored energy
Traffic, excavation, unstable surface, animal, or uncontrolled public exposure
Unknown valve, switch, disconnect, cross-connection, or service ownership
Critical-load impact or service interruption without operations authorization
Condition requiring emergency dispatch or work beyond assigned qualification
blocks.guidance: Check any condition observed or reported; checking an item does not mean the condition is controlled.

blocks.label: Qualified-person and stop-work boundary
blocks.guidance: Do not use this record to approach downed conductors, investigate a gas odor, enter flooded electrical areas, operate unknown valves or switches, or bypass dispatch control. Keep people clear, use the organization's emergency route, and allow only qualified and authorized personnel to isolate, test, repair, and restore the affected utility service.

blocks.label: Exception and escalation register
blocks.guidance: Link each customer request exception to supporting evidence and keep it open until disposition is recorded.

sections.title: Utility service decision, handoff, and accountable closeout
sections.guidance: Record the decision, remaining limitations, next action, and the people accountable for acceptance.

blocks.label: Closeout completeness
items: Electric, gas, water, or thermal utility service point identity and location were reconciled
Observed facts, measurements, and evidence references are complete
Decision authority and applicable review requirements were confirmed
Stop conditions, restrictions, and open exceptions remain visible
Customer, operations, or site handoff was recorded
Next action, owner, due point, and record-retention route are explicit

fields.label: Limitations, assumptions, restrictions, customer message, and next-action context

blocks.label: Accountable review and handoff
blocks.guidance: Signatures acknowledge the recorded decision and handoff; they do not waive unresolved restrictions.
